# Northstar Works Fictional Recruitment Agreement

This fictional agreement uses a success fee of 12% of the candidate's
first-year base salary for a completed placement. For a fictional annual
salary of 80,000 credits, the illustrative fee is 9,600 credits.

The currency unit, parties, and terms are invented for software testing. This
document is not a real offer, contract, or financial obligation.
